id_and_class.summary: Sri Aurobindo holds that Divine Consciousness (Sat-Chit-Ananda) is the foundation of existence and that it first veils itself in matter (involution) and then unfolds through life and mind (evolution). Since ‘nothing can evolve which is not already involved’, each higher stage manifests consciousness already hidden in the lower. He predicts that human mentality will give way to a supramental consciousness that becomes as natural a part of earthly life as ordinary mind is now.
id_and_class.core_identity_tagline: Consciousness as Divine Reality Evolving Through Matter

conceptual_ground.explanatory_identity_claim: Consciousness is Divine Consciousness-Force (Chit-Shakti), the one reality that appears as matter, life, mind, supermind, and spirit.
conceptual_ground.mind_body_relationship: Matter is Spirit in its most involved, primitive form, so there is no ontological gap between body and mind. Body, life, and mind are graded expressions of the same consciousness, and the material world is fully real.
conceptual_ground.emergence_type: Not applicable (higher forms of consciousness unfold from what was already involved in lower forms, as a tree unfolds from a seed)
conceptual_ground.subjectivity_and_intentionality: Human mind can play with ideas and rise above the immediate situation, but it is also an inveterate divider that splits subject from object and I from thou. Higher planes of mind progressively overcome this division.
conceptual_ground.ontological_commitments: Divine Consciousness (Sat-Chit-Ananda); a hierarchy of planes (matter, life, mind, Higher Mind, Illumined Mind, Intuitive Mind, Overmind, Supermind, spirit); involution and evolution as real cosmic processes.
conceptual_ground.epistemic_access: Yogic and spiritual practice (Integral Yoga) together with Vedāntic philosophy; higher planes are known by being lived, where truths are seen rather than thought.
conceptual_ground.constituents_and_structure: A tiered reality. In matter consciousness shows only as habit of form and obedience to fixed laws; in plants and animals it begins to show exchange, feelings, and drives; in humans it becomes reflective mind; above lie Higher, Illumined, and Intuitive Mind, the cosmic Overmind, and Supermind.

mechanism_and_dynamics.scope_of_consciousness: Cosmic consciousness; gradations of consciousness in matter, life, and mind; spiritual evolution and transformation.
mechanism_and_dynamics.distinctive_mechanism_or_principle: Involution followed by evolution. The Divine descends and hides in matter, appearing as unconsciousness, and evolution is the gradual re-emergence of what was hidden.
mechanism_and_dynamics.dynamics_of_emergence: Consciousness unfolds in stages over cosmic history: life from matter, mind from life, and next a supramental consciousness from mind. Aurobindo claims that this supramental transformation is becoming possible for the first time now.
mechanism_and_dynamics.location_and_distribution: Pervasive throughout reality, present in matter in a fully involved form and increasingly manifest in living beings and minds.
mechanism_and_dynamics.causation_and_functional_role: Consciousness-Force drives evolution itself, giving it direction and purpose as the Divine rediscovers and manifests itself in the world.
mechanism_and_dynamics.integration_or_binding: All levels are expressions of one Divine Consciousness. The highest stage reunites with the consciousness that upholds the universe while keeping the material world.
mechanism_and_dynamics.evolutionary_account: Evolution is purposeful, not random or purely mechanical. Each stage manifests consciousness that was already involved, and humanity is a key stage on the way to Supermind, not the endpoint.
core_claims_and_evidence: Nothing can evolve which is not already involved, so mind and life must be latent in matter.
The human mind is too imperfect to be nature's final form, and a higher consciousness will develop out of it as mind developed out of life.
Matter is Spirit in involved form, which bridges spiritual monism and scientific materialism.
A supramental transformation of all of human nature is the goal of evolution on Earth.
mechanism_and_dynamics.basis_of_belief_or_evidence_type: Spiritual and yogic experience, Vedāntic metaphysics, and philosophical argument.

empirics_and_critiques.criticisms_and_tensions: Treating evolution as directed toward a spiritual goal conflicts with the standard scientific view of evolution as undirected. The prediction of a coming supramental consciousness has no stated timeline or criteria for confirmation.
empirics_and_critiques.open_questions_and_limitations: Aurobindo does not explain how the hidden consciousness in matter becomes the specific experiences of individual organisms, or how the higher planes could be verified from outside.
empirics_and_critiques.ontological_coherence: Coherent as a spiritual monism that keeps matter real, unlike Vedāntic schools that treat the world as illusion. It sits between traditional Eastern idealism and scientific materialism.

survival_beyond_death.rationale: Since consciousness is the Divine reality that underlies matter, it does not depend on any one body, although Aurobindo's focus is on transformation of earthly life.

meaning_and_purpose.rationale: Evolution is a journey of self-discovery for the Divine, and human life is a stage in its progressive manifestation toward a divine life on Earth.
